Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000998": On 2026-01-13, Team Atlas noticed that the ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger)
- memory_id "1000994": On 2026-01-05, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Cinder, ledger)
- memory_id "1000986": As of 2025-12-29, the ledger remains an Ember team service.  (about: ledger, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000977": As of the 2025-12-29 rotation day, Diego is on call for the Ember team, having received the pager from Oskar.  (about: Diego, Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000862": As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to the Ember team.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000854": As of 2025-11-13, the ledger lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000714": As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger; it reads from the event bus instead.  (about: ledger, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000709" [decision]: On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger, Team Dune, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000706" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-12, the ledger must not be upgraded past Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000589": On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Team Cinder, ledger)
- memory_id "1000473": The Ember team holds its planning meeting every Friday.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000450": On 2025-05-23, the Ember team observed that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the webhooks service is not the Ember team's service.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000402" [constraint]: The billing service ships only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000379" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000376": INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000372": On 2025-04-26, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour during INC-2025-011.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000365" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000241" [constraint]: The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000236": The ledger depends on the auth gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000210": The reports pipeline depends on the ledger for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000205": The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings.  (about: ledger, billing service)
- memory_id "1000186" [constraint]: The reporting service may be released only on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC, and any other release time requires an exception.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000147" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: auth gateway)
Existing entity names: Team Atlas, ledger, Team Cinder, Ember team, Diego, Oskar, Team Dune, reporting service, event bus, webhooks service, billing service, INC-2025-011, auth gateway, reports pipeline
